description: Data-driven description of every change Argon makes to the pinned Firefox source: chrome files, branding, application identity, and preference defaults. scripts/argon.py apply reads this file; it owns no build logic of its own so the fork stays reviewable against upstream.

branding.note: Copied read-only into the upstream checkout so that --with-branding=browser/branding/argon resolves inside the source tree. The repository files themselves belong to the branding track.

replacements.new:
// Argon: remove the "More from Mozilla/Argon" pane completely.
    visible: () => false,

hooks.note: Initialize the Argon layout and extra panes before native routing and search. Keep the native about:preferences principal, controllers, feature gates and dialogs.

replacements.new: // Argon: the Support Argon/Firefox toggle, sponsored shortcuts, sponsored stories, and promo card are removed completely.

hooks.note: The New Tab settings pane must not expose a control that re-enables sponsored shortcuts. The pref defaults are disabled separately in argon/preferences/argon-prefs.js.

previous_replacements.new: // Argon: the sponsored shortcuts control is removed.

hooks.note: Application vendor and profile directory (application.ini Vendor and Profile fields). Both are project_flag() options upstream with possible_origins=('implied',), so they must be set via imply_option() rather than the mozconfig.

replacements.new: // Argon: sponsored and remote Suggest controls are not offered.

hooks.note: The Search pane must list only the engines Argon offers in onboarding, and never expose sponsored Firefox Suggest / Support Argon switches.
Treat the supported system DNS and disabled built-in password storage defaults as intentional; retain warnings for other security regressions.
